notes: Crossed channel by 6 July. Ebeling had written Aug 1771 prompting the tour.
Arrived 15 July. 15 days between Brussels and Antwerp combined.
Arrived 6 August. Brief halts in intervening cities. Met Cannabich. APPROXIMATE departure.
Arrived 16 August. Louis Devisme (British plenipotentiary) 'of greatest assistance'. Got into Elector's library. Met Guadagni, Regina Mingotti, the Elector and his wife. APPROXIMATE departure.
